source_identity_rule: Recheck the current issuer calendar, then require exactly one issuer press listing anchor titled TSMC October 2026 Revenue Report. Preserve its issued-on date and exactly one same-host /system/files/newspdf/ PDF attachment. Do not use the mutable investor monthly table as historical vintage.
required_evidence: actual UTC request/response time, HTTP status, Date/Age/Cache-Control/Last-Modified headers and exact URL
original calendar/listing/article/PDF bytes and SHA256 for every successful response
target absent/present for each frozen observation without publication-time invention
calendar-change/access errors separated from issuer listing presence
same article/PDF URLs and byte hashes compared across phases for revisions
stop_conditions: No HTTP before each phase not-before UTC; if phase missed, record missed without backfill.
If calendar changes or is inaccessible, record that limit; source listing may still be observed, but do not claim the predeclared schedule held.
Multiple matching article IDs, wrong issuer host, missing or multiple monthly-report PDF links, or non-PDF attachment: preserve receipts and stop source qualification.
No market outcome reads, Qlib factor/model, SOXX account, orders, subscriptions or purchases.
scientific_boundary: At best this captures observed first accessible issuer bytes for one prospective monthly event. It does not retroactively certify earlier TSM releases or count as an independent strategy forward day.
next_action: Pin implementation SHA after code/test, then schedule exactly three frozen observations in the existing Goal chat. Revalidate calendar on each run.
